clauses: The scenario envelope for market-day applies to products amber and blue in integer units of demand, not to orders or sales already observed.
For market-day, amber demand may be any integer from zero through eight inclusive. Blue demand may be any integer from zero through eight inclusive.
For the same market-day period, amber demand plus blue demand is exactly eight units. This combined constraint excludes simultaneous demand of eight units of each product.
Last week's amber sales were twelve units. An earlier point forecast suggested one blue unit. Neither statement changes the target-period scenario bounds.
